get_subaccounts_for_account.description: List the sub-accounts under a customer account: SubAccountUid/Id, the products each has enabled, and active flag. Active: 0=inactive, 1=active. Product families: CA=Chat Apps (the messaging channel/Viber/etc.), SM=SMS, VI=Video, VO=Voice, V8=Verify. Global config data (AppCatalog / AppDb, replicated cross-region), so results are the same from any region.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Optional portal user id (uniqueidentifier / GUID) to scope the list to sub-accounts that user can see. Omit (passed as null) to return all sub-accounts on the account — the SP treats null as 'all'.

get_subaccount.description: Get one sub-account's details and settings. Decode result codes: Active 0=inactive, 1=active; ProtectionStatusId (fraud/traffic protection) 0=Disabled, 1=Monitoring, 2=Alerts Enabled; MsgProcessingFlags is an OR-combined bitmask 1=DrReceived, 2=DrSent, 4=DrDeliveredToCarrier, 8=FinalDr, 16=OptOutMo. Product families: CA=Chat Apps, SM=SMS, VI=Video, VO=Voice, V8=Verify. Global config data (AppCatalog / AppDb, replicated).

parameters.name: SubAccountUid
parameters.description: Sub-account identifier (integer). Required. Get valid values from get_subaccounts_for_account.

get_account_balance.description: Current pre-paid billing balance for a customer account. Amounts are in the account's own billing currency (the result carries the currency). Balance changes constantly, so this tool caches only briefly. Global config data (AppCatalog / AppDb).

get_channels_config.description: Chat-apps / the messaging channel configuration for a customer account: which channels are provisioned and each channel's state and the messaging channel template review status. Decode the result codes as follows. Channel type (ChannelTypeId): 0/13=SMS, 1=the messaging channel, 2=Facebook, 3=RCS, 4=AppleBusinessChat, 5=Viber, 6=Line, 7=WeChat, 8=Zalo, 9=Kakao, 10=ZaloNotification, 11=Instagram, 12=LineNotification, 14=Call, 15=Mock (two-letter codes: SM/SS, WA, FB, RC, AP, VB, LN, WC, ZL, KK, ZN, LO, IG, VO, MK). Channel status (single char): A=Active, D=Deployment, F=Failed, M=Migration, P=Pending, R=Rejected, S=Stopped, V=Validation. the messaging channel template status: 1=Approved, 2=Pending, 3=Rejected, 4=Pending deletion, 5=Deleted, 6=In appeal, 7=Disabled, 8=Paused. the messaging channel template category (current): 14=UTILITY, 15=AUTHENTICATION, 16=MARKETING (ids 1-13 are deprecated legacy categories). Global config data (AppCatalog / AppDb).
